nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Financial assistance scheme of Assam for needy patients requiring treatment and hospitalization, particularly where other government insurance pathways do not cover the case.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Poor/needy patients satisfying the current Assam Arogya Nidhi guidelines and eligible medical/hospital conditions.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Assam Arogya Nidhi.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
